text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The holiday season is nearly here…

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: The lineup for this year's Arima Kinen grand prix looks to be a step up above usual.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap, Super Creek, and Inari One are just a few of the Umamusume who've been bringing the heat this year.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: There's also Yaeno Muteki and Mejiro Ardan. And who could forget Sakura Chiyono O's miraculous comeback!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Everyone who's defined this generation is going to be there! Fans are calling it a dream race worthy of the grand prix title!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone is looking forward to the imminent Arima Kinen and the holiday season. Meanwhile, Bamboo Memory…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's get right to it, Trainer! It's the holidays, which means enforcing discipline is more important than ever!
choice_data_list: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Bamboo Memory, the disciplinary committee is fairly—make that extremely busy around this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing that, I decide to help out with her disciplinary committee work between our training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You can't take the holiday season lightly! This time of year is nuts!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The disciplinary committee has crunched the numbers and found that rule violations go up significantly around the holidays! We call it chaos season!
choice_data_list: Chaos season?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I think it's easier to understand if you see for yourself. So…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's patrol the academy! We need to tighten the screws, and that means being three times as loud, three times as strict, and three times as energetic!
choice_data_list: …Does "three" have some kind of significance?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course—it sounds cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins our super strict holiday season.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey! You over there! It's against the rules to bring a tree into the dorms without permission!

text_block_list.name: Tree-Toting Student
text_block_list.text: Oh! Bamboo! S-sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You there! Just because a classroom is empty doesn't mean you can use it to throw a party! You need to get permission first!

text_block_list.name: Student with Fairy Lights
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Where'd you come from?! A-anyway… sorry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Stop right there! Who said you could have a barbecue on the roof?! Clean everything up right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Student Holding Meat
text_block_list.text: But why?! Taiki Shuttle does it all the time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And Air Groove yells at her every time! Do you want me to call her over here?!

text_block_list.name: Student Holding Meat
text_block_list.text: …I'll clean it up.

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bamboo! Thanks for all your hard work on the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Did you get permission to leave campus?

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text: Oh you! Of course I did! Hehehe… Now, I'm just gonna go ahead and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not so fast! Your dorm leader's told me all about your habit of sneaking out! And I know for a fact you haven't given notice! I checked!

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I should have known you would've talked to her. There's no getting anything by you…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew! That should do it for today! Appreciate the help, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Sure thing! Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spent the whole day patrolling with Bamboo Memory. Both the scale and amount of rule violations were larger than I expected, and we've managed to run ourselves ragged.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: See? We don't call this chaos season for nothing. Everyone's so excited, they just do whatever they feel like!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But that's all the more reason why I've got to do what I can for the disciplinary committee!
choice_data_list: And why is that exactly?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I think everyone's just so excited about the holidays that they can't help themselves!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And so it's our job to make sure everyone enjoys the holidays safely!
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true disciplinary chair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory is working hard on the disciplinary committee for everyone's sake, and I'd like to show her some appreciation.
choice_data_list: Why don't we celebrate a job well done back in my office?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! Can we?! I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We can celebrate a job well done and the holidays at the same time! Besides, who knows when we'll get another chance to celebrate?!
choice_data_list: All right, let's go buy some cake!
All right, let's go buy some cake!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yesss! This is gonna be great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Bamboo Memory and I reward ourselves for our hard work by enjoying the holidays with some cake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us have a lovely time talking about all the times we've shared!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I nearly forgot! It's not a holiday party without—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoops! I left it in my room! And it's not even wrapped ye—
choice_data_list: You okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer! Would you mind picking up the cake by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll meet you back in your office! Just gotta grab something real quick, nothing to worry about!
choice_data_list: I don't really know what's going on, but okay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry! I'll be there right away, I swear! Just wait a bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As requested, I go pick up a cake and then wait for her in my office.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!
choice_data_list: No worries, but is everything okay?
No worries, but is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who suggested we make this a holiday party, but I totally forgot I wasn't prepared…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer!
choice_data_list: Y-yes?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I figured today is the best time to give you your present since we're celebrating and all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heh, I kinda had to rush a little bit with the wrapping 'cause I wasn't ready. Anyway, it's nothing special, but I hope you like it!
choice_data_list: Thank you! Can I open it?
Thank you! Can I open it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I unwrap my present from Bamboo Memory and find a super soft hand towel inside!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's beautifully decorated with an intricate bamboo pattern, and the kanji character for "dreams" is embroidered across one of the edges.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I've told you my dad does kendo, right? Well, he and I both really love this brand! Their towels are durable, soft, and super handy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You can use it to mop up sweat, or whatever you want, honestly. Here's hoping you get a lot of use out of it!
choice_data_list: Thank you! I really like the embroidery.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Actually, I did that part myself!
choice_data_list: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It wasn't easy, but I had some help from Ardan! Still, I'm glad it turned out okay!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I thought it might be a bit boring if I just gave you a towel, so I wanted to give it my own special touch!
choice_data_list: Thanks, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An attack of emotion sweeps over me, and I worry I might have to put the hand towel to use right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm so glad you like it! The look on your face right now is the best present I could ask for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Now that we've exchanged presents, let's get this party started! Thanks for all your hard work and happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Bamboo Memory and I reward ourselves for our hard work by enjoying the holidays with some cake, all the while chatting about the times we've shared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, I promise myself that I'll treasure my new dream-embroidered hand towel.
